comparisons.peer_summary: In Q4 FY2024, the Company recorded a $58 million impairment charge for certain in-process R&D in the Data Center segment, related to the 2024 Restructuring Plan.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Avago disclosed non-recurring charges within their restructuring results for fiscal year 2024. Avago reported $204 million in non-recurring IP litigation charges, whereas AMD recorded a $58 million impairment charge for In-Process R&D (IPR&D) assets as a result of its 2024 Restructuring Plan. While both represent non-cash or legal settlements tied to restructuring initiatives, the nature of the charges differs: Avago's was litigation-related, while AMD's was an asset impairment of IPR&D.

sentences.text: Restructuring and other charges in our consolidated statement of operations for fiscal year 2023 included $204 million of non-recurring charges related to IP litigation.

During the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2024, the Company determined that the fair value of certain IPR&D recorded within the Data Center segment was not recoverable resulting from actions related to the 2024 Restructuring Plan, and recorded an impairment charge of $58 million within Restructuring charges in the Company's Consolidated Statement of Operations.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company incurred $83 million in non-cash impairment charges on certain operating leased assets as a direct result of the 2024 Restructuring Plan, recorded within restructuring and other charges in the third quarter of 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Intel and Avago both included non-recurring charges in their restructuring and other charges categories. Intel recorded $83 million in non-cash impairment charges on operating leased assets directly resulting from its 2024 Restructuring Plan. Avago reported $204 million in non-recurring charges related to IP litigation. Both items appear in the same financial line item ('restructuring and other charges'), but the drivers differ significantly: Intel's charge was driven by asset impairment due to restructuring actions, while Avago's was driven by legal settlements.

sentences.text: Restructuring and other charges in our consolidated statement of operations for fiscal year 2023 included $204 million of non-recurring charges related to IP litigation.

We also incurred non-cash impairment charges of $83 million on certain operating leased assets as a direct result of the 2024 Restructuring Plan (see "Note 7: Restructuring and Other Charges" within Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements).
These charges were included within restructuring and other in the third quarter of 2024.
